SECURITY ADVISORY (4/5)                 
========================================
> DEBIAN DSA                            
  Debian: Apache2 Security Flaw         
                                        
  Debian security advisory DSA-6620-1   
  addresses security vulnerabilities    
  within the Apache2 HTTP server        
  package. System administrators should 
  upgrade apache2 packages via apt to   
  secure web services.                  
                                        
  Source: Debian DSA (2026-11-12)
